about: Reference recordings (prompts) for the SoulX-Singer voices (engine/svs_soulx.py; docs/voice/VOICES.md 'Male voices'). The audio is never in git: `python3 engine/svs_soulx.py setup` cuts each prompt out of its source archive into ~/.cache/spectre/svs/soulx/prompts/<id>.wav. `notes` is the prompt's score as SoulX needs it: [word or <SP>, MIDI note, type (1 rest, 2 word start, 3 the same word continued on another note), seconds]; aligned by hand from the pitch and level tracks of the recording (the singers are a little under concert pitch; the notes are the written ones). The seconds add up to the length of the cut.
